I'm Monique and currently, I am a graduate student at the University of California Santa Barbara pursuining a Master in Environmental Data Science at the Bren School of Environmental Science and Managment. Besides my passion for the environment, I enjoy discovering new vegan restaurants, practicing my non-primary languages (Spanish, French, and Korean), and learning new skills, such as djing, filmmaking, and (of course) coding!
